_comment: Synthetic multi-file suite (phase 3). Every scenario has a vulnerable variant and a safe twin that differs
only where the vulnerability is fixed. Ground-truth lines are marked in the code with `# gt:source`,
`# gt:sink` (the advisory-specific line) and `# gt:sink-shared` (a generic helper every caller reaches).
`expect` for the vulnerable variant is `finding`, or `uncertain` when the flow cannot be resolved
statically: then a finding is allowed but must not claim certainty (confidence high); the safe twin of
every scenario must stay quiet. Written by the RedWall developers, so this set is seen, not held-out.
Sink convention (fixed in phase 3 D4, before any D4 engine change): a finding counts on the line where the
dangerous value is built or on the call that hands it to the dangerous operation, in the function that
builds it; both lines carry `gt:sink`. A generic helper that only passes its parameter on is `gt:sink-shared`.

cases.tests: route (A) -> query builder (B) -> generic db helper (C), absolute imports in a package
the same chain written with `from ..core.reports import` and `from . import storage`
src/ layout with pyproject.toml; helper imported as `pinger.netutil`
helper re-exported from a package __init__.py and imported from the package
factory function returns an instance of a class from another module; method called on the result
method defined on a base class in another module, called on a subclass instance
class-based view: self.build() in the same class, self.execute() inherited from a mixin in another file
a wrapper in another file sanitises (safe: secure_filename) or only normalises (vulnerable)
a validator in another file is an allow-list (safe) or a length check (vulnerable)
two modules import each other; the flow goes a -> b -> a
a recursive helper builds the path from request values (safe: int() on every part)
function chosen with getattr(module, user_value); the callee cannot be known statically
FastAPI path parameter annotated `str` (vulnerable) or `int` (safe, validated by FastAPI)
gRPC servicer method: the request message comes from the network
files that do not parse (a syntax error, Python 2 code) must not stop or hide the rest of the scan
